note: All numbers verified against actual report files. Sources listed per metric.

hybrid_bm25_dense.note: worse retrieval AND worse verifier F1 than bm25_only

hybrid_bm25_sentence_transformer.note: better retrieval recall@10 but worse verifier macro_F1 than bm25_only

retrieval.profile_comparison_conclusion: bm25_only is the default. Better retrieval ranking does not monotonically improve end-to-end verifier macro-F1 in this evaluation.

robust_verifier_retrain.root_cause: Combined training set was 55% NEI due to 76% NEI in retrieved-evidence calibration set. Without class reweighting, model collapsed toward NEI predictions.

relevance_gate.status: disabled by default (relevance_gate_threshold: null in configs/serving.yaml)
relevance_gate.conclusion: Gate reduces NEI FPR substantially but regresses macro_F1. Threshold was calibrated on per-passage pair data, not claim-level aggregation. Gate stays disabled until calibrated at claim level.

onnx_benchmark.hardware: CPU only (no CUDA, no MPS path in onnxruntime)
onnx_benchmark.conclusion: ONNX CPU is slower than native transformers on this Mac (55 vs 62 ex/s at batch=1). MPS via transformers (153 ex/s) is 3x faster than ONNX CPU. ONNX export is validated and functional; the speedup benefit applies on CUDA hardware, not on this Mac.
onnx_benchmark.claim_forbidden: ONNX is faster on this hardware

verdict_prediction_adapter.note: Trained on verifier-format oracle data. NEI F1=0.0 because the base model defaults to SUPPORTED/REFUTED, rarely generating NEI.

explanation_adapter.format_compliance_note: Low at 80 iters / 256 examples. Structured output compliance needs more training.
explanation_adapter.previous_bug: Adapter was trained against Qwen/Qwen3-0.6b (hidden_dim=1024) instead of Qwen2.5-1.5B (hidden_dim=1536) due to base_model/model key mismatch in training script.

Ablated 3 retrieval profiles (bm25_only, hybrid_bm25_dense, hybrid_bm25_sentence_transformer) at full 650-example scale
Documented two negative results: verifier robustness retrain regressed (-0.1058 macro_F1), relevance gate improved NEI FPR but regressed macro_F1
Exported DistilRoBERTa verifier to ONNX; benchmarked at 55 ex/s CPU
Trained MLX LoRA adapter on Apple Silicon (Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct-4bit, 53.7 tok/s); verdict_accuracy 0.695, macro_F1 0.4632 on 200-example eval
Generated SFT and DPO preference datasets for Phi-3 fine-tuning; created Colab training notebook
136 passing tests across verifier, retrieval, inference, and gate components

Phi-3 QLoRA or DPO adapter trained (CUDA not available, no adapter exists)
